variables.name: OCX_BIN_SUBPATH
variables.note: This is an internal constant of the installer, not a setting, so there is nothing to expose.

variables.name: OCX_EXTRA_CA_CERTS
variables.note: The installer derives it from the CA bundle. The feature sets it from caBundle so ocx trusts that bundle at run time.

variables.name: OCX_HOME
variables.note: The ocxHome option sets it for all users. Empty keeps the default ~/.ocx of each user.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_CA_BUNDLE
variables.note: The caBundle option names a PEM file inside the image that is trusted for every download.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_DIST_URL
variables.note: The distUrl option replaces the bundled release manifest with one fetched over HTTPS.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_DOWNLOADER
variables.note: The feature probes for curl first and falls back to wget, so no choice is needed.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_FORCE
variables.note: An image layer is always a fresh install, so there is never an existing version to replace.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_MIRROR_URL
variables.note: The mirrorUrl option downloads release archives from your own host. Checksums are still enforced.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_NO_SETUP
variables.note: Always on: the feature never runs ocx self setup, which would write the build user's profiles and store. The shellActivation option covers shell setup.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_NO_SMOKETEST
variables.note: Always off: the feature smoke-tests the installed binary every time, so a broken install fails the build.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_PRINT_PATH
variables.note: A feature build has no consumer for the printed path, and the installDir option already states it.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_QUIET
variables.note: The build log is the only feedback channel in a container build, so the output stays on.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_REPO
variables.note: The distUrl and mirrorUrl options cover alternative sources and keep checksum verification enforced.

variables.name: OCX_INSTALL_VERSION
variables.note: The version option takes an exact version, pinned or latest. The upstream default is the latest release, here it is pinned.

variables.name: OCX_MANAGED_CONFIG
variables.note: The managedConfig option sets the OCI reference of an organisation-managed ocx configuration.

variables.name: OCX_NO_MODIFY_PATH
variables.note: Always on: no per-user profile is modified at build time. Setting shellActivation to false is the equivalent switch for the project toolchain.

featureOnly.note: The upstream installer detects the C library itself, while the feature defaults to musl, which runs on every Linux image.
The installer uses the per-user store, while the feature places the binary in one directory that is on PATH.
The installer has no counterpart, while the feature turns off the ocx update check by default so the container makes no needless network call.
The installer has no counterpart, while the feature lets projects under the listed paths activate without a prompt.
The installer only installs ocx, while the feature can also restore the project toolchain at build time.
The installer has no toolchain step, while the feature restores the listed tool groups when pull is on.
The installer edits shell profiles itself, while the feature puts the project toolchain on PATH in new shells on request.
